# xskill

> A skills management tool for discovering, installing, and managing reusable agent skill packs across multiple AI coding platforms.

Use the current documentation at https://xskill.gcli.cn/man/en/ as the source of truth.
Config file lives at `~/.xskill/settings.json` (override with `XSKILL_CONFIG`). Installs track state in `.xskill-lock.json` for reproducibility.

## Install and set up

Install the latest release for the current user:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://xskill.gcli.cn/install.sh | bash
```

On Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://xskill.gcli.cn/install.ps1 | iex
```

Alternative install paths (npm, crates.io, git, source) are documented under Installation.

After install, the `xskill` binary is on PATH. Configure a source, then query and install:

```sh
xskill sources add -n my-skills -u https://github.com/example/skills
xskill query -f my-skills vue
xskill add -f my-skills -s vue
xskill list
```

Use `xskill --help` and `xskill <command> --help` as the command-line authority.

## Workflow basics

```sh
# Install to global directory
xskill add -f my-skills -s vue -g

# Interactively find and install skills (multi-select TUI, requires cache)
xskill find
xskill find --skill git
xskill find --from antfu

# Link existing skills to a platform
xskill link -s vue -a claude

# Update installed skills from lock file
xskill update

# Restore skills from a project lock file
xskill restore

# Remove a skill
xskill remove -s vue

# Debug mode (show git command details)
xskill -v add -f my-skills -s vue
```
